articles.title: Meloni, l'Europa difenda i propri confini con umanità ma anche intransigenza
articles.summary: Meloni announced on social media that a new regime of sanctions against criminal networks exploiting migrant trafficking represents an important signal toward European immigration reform.

articles.title: Meloni: 'Con Trump non mi pento di nulla, punto all'unità dell'Occidente'
articles.summary: At the NATO summit in Ankara, Meloni stated she has no regrets about her political investment in relations with Trump and confirmed Italy's commitment to increase defense spending in a sustainable manner.

articles.title: Meloni: 'Un presidente della Repubblica di destra potrebbe non essere più un tabù'
articles.summary: Meloni stated that a right-wing president of the Republic might no longer be a taboo if her majority wins the next elections, suggesting the right deserves equal representation at all levels.

articles.title: 'Diffamata da Corona', Giorgia Meloni pronta a testimoniare in aula a Milano
articles.summary: Meloni announced her availability to testify as a plaintiff in the Milan courthouse on September 28 in a defamation case against Fabrizio Corona.
